title: Rethinking Toxicity Evaluation in Large Language Model: A Multi-Label Perspective

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating language models and toxicity detectors on their ability to accurately identify and classify multiple simultaneous safety violations (e.g., identity-based hatred, harassment, physical harm risk) using a 15-category multi-label taxonomy across three new benchmark datasets (Q-A-MLL, R-A-MLL, H-X-MLL), measured via mean Average Precision (mAP) and Label Ranking Loss.
